pages.title: CHANNEL 9 FIRST ALERT
pages.text: $(bold)CHANNEL 9 FIRST ALERT WEATHER$()$(br2)Chief Meteorologist Patti Langmore's final forecast.$(br2)$(bold)Today:$() High of -37°F. Winds 45 mph, gusting to 70.$(br2)For reference, the record low for this date was -12°F, set in 1987.$(br2)$(italic)"So we are just SHATTERING that."$()

pages.title: Nitrogen Precipitation
pages.text: Patti also mentioned "nitrogen precipitation," which she described as "apparently a thing that can happen now."$(br2)$(bold)Model Comparison:$()$(br)$(li)European model shows return to seasonal norms$(li)GFS shows decline to -60°F$(li)Canadian model stopped updating three days ago$(br2)$(italic)"I'm going with the European model because it makes me feel better."$()

pages.title: Technical Difficulties
pages.text: $(bold)Server Note:$()$(br2)$(italic)"Our servers are in the basement and the basement flooded and then the flood froze. IT is working on it."$()$(br2)This was the final Channel 9 weather broadcast. The station lost power the following morning.
